reviewPassage:
Residents’ Notice | Window screens

If you see insects near a window even though the mesh looks intact, check the lower corners of the screen frame. Dust sometimes stops the screen from sliding fully into its track.

First, wipe the track with a dry cloth. Then move the frame all the way to one side and inspect the opposite corner. Slide the frame back to see whether it now seats properly. A corner that closes again after cleaning does not need a replacement strip.

Please do not fill the gap with tape. A service technician must be able to remove the frame without damaging it.

You can send us a photo if the gap remains. Include the whole frame, not just the opening. The edge of the frame is our reference point; without it, the size of the gap is hard to gauge.
